author: issue-39-density worker
hypothesis: Decision scarcity is intrinsic to the domain, so observed-fee replay evaluation becomes usable only when arrivals, evaluation-window length and seed count together yield enough observed decisions; measure the density instead of raising probabilities.
conclusion: Realized decision density is stable at ~1.2-2.1e-5 per introduction (~1.1e-4 counterfactual). A 30-day window at 20/20 gives 0.6-1.0 expected decisions per seed and is degenerate even with 20 seeds; 50/50 x 30 days x 20 seeds gives ~50 (usable); 100/100 gives ~28-113 (robust); follow-up 150/150 gives ~103-120 and 200/200 ~180-193 per 20 seeds (single seed ~5-10). At 150-200/200 the 5/day cap is ~97-99% saturated while effective pool exhaustion falls to 1.7-2.3%, so the cap (not the pool) binds; daily referrals still grow near-linearly. 200/200 needs 3.36M events / 1.78 GiB per 180-day seed, so 50/50 remains the production 20-seed default. No probability changes are proposed; see docs/MARKET_DENSITY.md.

analysis.definition_decision: events.kettei_dt IS NOT NULL; daily.decisions is the observed decision count per day
analysis.definition_cap_utilization: distinct (day, user_id) with exactly 5 introductions / all distinct (day, user_id) introduced
analysis.definition_zero_referral_share: 1 - distinct introduced users that day / daily.live_users
analysis.definition_pool: occupation equal AND (region equal OR allows_remote) AND max(100, offered_salary-100) <= desired_salary; effective pool also excludes seen pairs

results.bottleneck_verdict: At 150-200/200 the 5/day cap is 97-99% saturated (effectively binding), but daily referrals still grow near-linearly; pool tightness recedes (effective zero-share 6.5% -> 2.3% -> 1.7%), so the pool is not the bottleneck.
results.usable_combination: 50/50 arrivals, 30-day window, >=20 seeds (expected ~50 decisions) remains the production default; 100/100 works with 5-20 seeds (~28-113); 150/150 gives ~103-120 and 200/200 ~180-193 per 20 seeds (single seed ~5-10) but 200/200 needs ~1.78 GiB per 180-day seed; 20/20 needs a ~120-180 day window or ~50 seeds
